verdicts.reason: A reads left to right like a banner, and the headline stays dominant. But the 'See the Flavours' CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill whose text is barely legible, and it is jammed against the right edge. The headline also sits close to the left and top edges. B's headline is smaller and pushed right of centre, leaving a large dead area on the left. Its CTA is also tiny, crammed in tight under the headline and nearly touching the bottom edge, and only roughly lines up with the second line, so it looks like an afterthought rather than a deliberate layout.
